Max pending dirt-to-grass restores queued per chunk
ethological.configuration.comfort.crowd_: Preferred clear space (blocks) animals aim for when choosing where to walk or stand. Soft preference only - never physically pushes animals
ethological.configuration.comfort.sleep_: Horizontal gap between herd members' individual sleep spots (0 = no gap, just never two on the same block)
ethological.configuration.comfort.yield_: If true, a stationary animal steps aside when a pathing herd-mate is stuck against it
ethological.configuration.comfort.hunger: Global hunger drain speed for every species (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half as fast)
ethological.configuration.comfort.thirst: Global thirst drain speed for every species (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half as fast)
ethological.configuration.compat.better_: If true and Better Days is installed, hunger/thirst drain scales with the current day length so animals eat and drink the same number of times per day-cycle
ethological.configuration.compat.freshAn: ON lets Fresh Animations own entity models (with Ethological syncing behavior), OFF disables all FA integration, AUTO uses Ethological's own renderers when no FA pack is active
ethological.configuration.compat.syncEat: Make the FA grazing animation trigger from Ethological's eat behavior instead of only when standing on grass/wheat/hay. Requires the companion resource pack.
ethological.configuration.compat.sleepOv: Force FA animals into Ethological's lying-down pose while sleeping or resting, instead of letting FA keep them standing up
ethological.configuration.compat.packOve: Let Ethological override other resource packs' models and textures for resting and sleeping animals (its lying-down pose and dedicated sleep/rest textures). Off lets Fresh Animations and other packs keep their own resting/sleeping visuals; Ethological behavior and eating sync still run
ethological.configuration.sleepModels.to: Show Ethological's lying-down models for cow, sheep, pig, and chicken while they sleep or rest. Off keeps animals in their standing model even when put to sleep by the mod; behavior is unaffected
ethological.configuration.modernBabyMode: Use the newer Minecraft baby models for cow, sheep, pig, and chicken. Off keeps vanilla baby animals.
ethological.configuration.comfort.avoid_: If true, natural herd spawns are rejected on cliff edges and steep drops so herds never form on cliff faces
ethological.configuration.comfort.y_pena: How strongly the food/water search prefers targets near the animal's own height (16 = moderate, 0 = pure nearest)
